# dynamodb

DynamoDB access patterns - Query over Scan, key conditions, bounded reads - plus table posture (PITR, deletion protection) from dumps.

## Rules

| Rule | Severity | Title |
|---|---|---|
| `AF-DATA-009` | high | DynamoDB Scan without limit or filter |
| `AF-DATA-010` | medium | DynamoDB Query without a key condition |
| `AF-STORE-001` | high | DynamoDB table has point-in-time recovery disabled |
| `AF-STORE-002` | medium | DynamoDB table has deletion protection off |
